LV= home insurance covers water or oil leaking from any fixed tank, domestic appliance, or pipe, as well as loss of metered water or oil . [1] [2] Additionally, they will pay up to £5,000 towards the cost to remove and replace any part of the building to find the source of a water or oil leak from these installations . [6] Exclusions related to water or oil leaking from fixed installations include:
- Damage caused by failure, wear and tear, or lack of grouting or sealant . [1] [2] - Loss or damage after your home has been unoccupied for more than 60 days in a row, unless your personal details show that this cover has been agreed . [1] [2]

Thanks for choosing LV= home insurance.
In this booklet, you’ll find everything you need to know about your cover – including
what is covered and what isn’t - so please keep it safe with your personal details.

home buildings and/or contents. The level of cover and any optional extras you’ve

or recommendations as to whether this product meets your specific insurance
requirements. You should review your insurance requirements on a regular basis.

these are not directly influenced by your decision to purchase this policy.
All communications will be in English. You can get this and other documents from
us in Braille, large print or audiotape by contacting us.

Section: 27. Liability to domestic employees

If following an accident your
domestic employee dies, is injured,
or falls ill whilst being employed by
you and you’re found legally liable,
we’ll pay up to £10,000,000 for any
claim from one incident, including
claimants’ costs and expenses.
We may also pay other costs and
expenses that have incurred with
our permission, within this limit.
This cover applies anywhere in the
world, as long as you entered the
contract of employment with the
employee in the British Isles.

result.query: What does AXA Plus Home say about bicycles under contents cover?
result.answer:
AXA Plus Home Insurance states the following about bicycles under contents cover:

1. **Bicycle Cover**: Bicycle cover is included in the contents policy, covering bicycles worth £350 each or less (up to £1,500 in total) when at or away from the home . [1] 2. **Coverage Limits**: Bicycles worth more than £350 each must be added to the policy to be covered under the Bicycle section . [1] 3. **Unadded Bicycles**: Bicycles worth more than £350 each which haven’t been added to the policy won’t be fully covered if a claim is made . [1] [5] 4. **Accessories Covered**: The coverage includes tyres and accessories, bicycle helmets, helmet-mounted cycling cameras, cycling computers, cycling GPS units, bicycle lights, cycling luggage, bicycle tools, and cycling armour and guards . 5. **Exclusions**: Exclusions include theft when the bicycle is unattended unless it is in a locked building, locked motor vehicle, or secured by a suitable locking device to a permanent structure or a motor vehicle. Additionally, theft when the bicycle is mounted on a motor vehicle is excluded unless both the bicycle and the mount have a suitable locking device in operation. Damage while being used for racing, pace making, or trials is also excluded . [5]

result.query: In AXA Premier 2023 what must the policyholder tell AXA about changes to their home?
result.answer:
The policyholder must inform AXA about the following changes to their home:

1. If they alter the number of bedrooms or bathrooms in their home. 2. If the total of 'other' rooms they told AXA about changes. 3. If they or their family intend to let or sub-let the home. 4. If the home is used for business purposes other than clerical work. 5. If the home will be unoccupied. 6. If they are making structural changes to the home, as failing to do so could invalidate the policy . [4] Failure to inform AXA about these changes may result in:
- The policy being cancelled. - The policy being declared void (treated as if it never existed). - Changes to the terms and/or premium of the policy. - Refusal to deal with any relevant claims or a reduction in the amount of any related claim payments . [6]

Welcome AXA Premier Home Insurance – Welcome Page 3 of 67Go to Content page Guide to your policy wording Thank you for choosing AXA Insurance as your insurance provider. We have included some features designed to make reading your policy online as easy as possible. Information just a click away To go straight to the section you are interested in simply go to the ‘Content page’ and click on the underlined words. Section: Top Tip:

Many thefts are committed by so-called ‘opportunist’ criminals. Don’t make it easy for them!
Homes, garages and sheds are significantly more likely to be burgled if doors and windows
are not locked and secured.
If you are going away do what you can to make your house appear occupied. Ask a neighbour
to pick up the mail, cancel any other regular deliveries and use timer on lights if you have them.
Garages and sheds are attractive to criminals as they are easier to break in to and often
contain items that thieves target such as tools or golf clubs. Locking garages and sheds
is another important step to minimising the risk of theft.
Loss or damage:
■ while your home is unoccupied or unfurnished;
■ if property is obtained by any person using any form of payment which proves to be counterfeit,
false, fraudulent, invalid, uncollectible, irrecoverable or irredeemable for any reason;
■ as a result of any failed online purchase or transaction;
■ from the home if any part of it is occupied by anyone other than you or your family unless there
has been forcible or violent entry to or exit from the home;
■ caused by you, your family, lodgers, paying guests or tenants.

result.answer:
In AXA Premier Home Insurance 2023, the following is stated about escape of water damage:

1. **What is covered under escape of water damage?**
   - Loss or damage resulting from escape of water is covered . [1] [2] - This includes sudden and unexpected water leaking from or freezing in any washing machine, dishwasher, fridge, freezer, or fixed domestic water, drainage, or heating installation . [2] - The policy also covers necessary and reasonable costs incurred in tracing and accessing the source of the damage to the home . [2] 2. **What are the limitations or exclusions related to escape of water damage?**
   - Damage to the fittings, installation, and appliances themselves is only covered if the damage has happened as a result of an insured cause or cover . [2] - There is no coverage for damage while your home is unoccupied or unfurnished . - Damage caused by sinks and baths overflowing as a result of the taps being left on is also excluded . 3. **What additional costs are covered in relation to escape of water damage?**
   - The policy covers necessary and reasonable costs incurred in tracing and accessing the source of the damage to the home, including reinstating any wall, floor, ceiling, drive, fence, or path removed or damaged during the search . [2] 4. **What preventative measures are suggested for escape of water damage?**
   - It is suggested to keep central heating on low to prevent pipes from freezing . [4]

Your cover for escape of water is designed to cover damage to your property caused by water leaks. result.query: In the AXA Premier 2025 wording what are the steps for making a home insurance claim?
result.answer:
To make a home insurance claim under the AXA Premier Home Insurance policy, you should follow these steps:

1. Ensure everyone at home is safe and not at risk. 2. Do as much as you can to stop further damage (e.g., turn off gas, electricity, or water supply if safe). 3. Call the police if anything has been stolen, lost, or damaged by someone other than you, and obtain a crime or lost property reference number. 4. Do what you reasonably can to recover missing property and/or prevent further loss. 5. Register your claim in the usual way if the incident is covered by your policy . [2] [3] When you make your claim, AXA will:
- Put you in touch with a knowledgeable and trained member of staff who can discuss the claim and explain the next steps. - Call you back when promised. - Give you regular updates on your claim . [2] It is important to note that if you do not follow the conditions of the policy, AXA may not deal with all or part of your claim, or may pay a lower amount. You should check your cover before making a claim, as your schedule will show what sections you are covered for . [2]

case.query: What does AXA Premier 2025 say about cancellation of the policy?

gold_evidence.quote:
You can cancel this policy in the first 14 days of receiving your policy documents or the start 
date, whichever is later. If your cover hasn’t started we will refund the full premium to you. 
If your cover has started, we will cancel this policy back to its start date and we will refund 
the full premium to you, as long as no claims have happened.

You can cancel this policy at any other time, as long as none of the following applies. 
 ■ You haven’t had payment for a claim.
 ■ You aren’t making a claim. 
 ■ You haven’t suffered a loss for which you intend to claim.
If you decide to cancel your policy, you will only pay for the number of days we have covered 
you for since the start date. We may charge you a cancellation fee.

result.query: What does AXA Premier 2025 say about cancellation of the policy?
result.answer:
The AXA Premier Home Insurance policy outlines the following regarding cancellation:

1. **14-Day Cancellation Rights**: You can cancel the policy within the first 14 days of receiving your policy documents or the start date, whichever is later. If your cover has started, the policy will be canceled back to its start date, and you will receive a full refund of the premium, provided no claims have been made . 2. **Cancellation After 14 Days**: You can cancel the policy at any time after the 14-day period, but only if you have not had payment for a claim, are not making a claim, and have not suffered a loss for which you intend to claim. If you cancel, you will only pay for the number of days covered since the start date, and a cancellation fee may apply . [2] [4] 3. **Cancellation Fees**: If you cancel the policy outside the 14-day period, a £30 admin fee will be charged. If you have paid the full premium for the policy year, this fee will be deducted from any refund due to you . [6] [8] 4. **Claims and Cancellation**: If you have already received payment for a claim or are in the process of making a claim, you cannot cancel the policy back to its start date, and you will not receive any refund of premium . [1] [4] 5. **Insurer Cancellation Rights**: AXA reserves the right to cancel your policy and charge a fee if you provide false information, fail to pay your premium, or do not inform them of changes in your circumstances . [4] [12] These points summarize the cancellation terms and conditions as specified in the AXA Premier Home Insurance policy.

result.query: What does FCA ICOBS 8.1.1 require about handling claims promptly and fairly?
result.answer: FCA ICOBS 8.1.1 requires insurers to handle claims promptly and fairly by ensuring they: (1) handle claims promptly and fairly; (2) provide reasonable guidance to help a policyholder make a claim and appropriate information on its progress; (3) not unreasonably reject a claim (including by terminating or avoiding a policy); and (4) settle claims promptly once settlement terms are agreed . result.query: What does the Consumer Duty say about unfairly exploiting behavioural biases or vulnerability?
result.answer: The Consumer Duty states that firms must ensure that no aspect of their business involves unfairly exploiting behavioural biases displayed or characteristics of vulnerability held by retail customers . Specifically, it prohibits manipulating or exploiting retail customers, such as by manipulating their emotions or behavioural biases to mislead or create demand for a product . [7] Additionally, firms are not allowed to take advantage of a retail customer or their circumstances, particularly any characteristics of vulnerability, in a manner likely to cause detriment . [8] When dealing with a particular retail customer, firms must pay appropriate regard to the needs and characteristics of that customer, including any characteristics of vulnerability .

We include home assistance insurance in your policy. Your schedule shows your cover limits. This cover gives you emergency help should a home emergency happen. We will cover you for the home emergencies shown in the table from page 56, onwards. If any of these causes are a risk to your health and safety or make your home unsafe to live in, you should contact us. This cover is suitable for those who want cover for sudden, unexpected emergencies that are listed further below. It covers the cost of emergency repairs only and not the damage caused by the emergency. It is not suitable for those that already have another policy that covers these emergencies. Please note that the home assistance cover is separate from your buildings and contents cover. If you are a tenant please check you have your landlord’s permission to use this cover. It’s not designed to replace your buildings and contents insurance and won’t help with normal day to day home maintenance. Section: Home assistance insurance

We include home assistance insurance in your policy. Your schedule shows your cover limits. This cover gives you emergency help should a home emergency happen. We will cover you for the home emergencies shown in the table from page 56, onwards. If any of these causes are a risk to your health and safety or make your home unsafe to live in, you should contact us. This cover is suitable for those who want cover for sudden, unexpected emergencies that are listed further below. It covers the cost of emergency repairs only and not the damage caused by the emergency. It is not suitable for those that already have another policy that covers these emergencies. Please note that the home assistance cover is separate from your buildings and contents cover. If you are a tenant please check you have your landlord’s permission to use this cover. It’s not designed to replace your buildings and contents insurance and won’t help with normal day to day home maintenance. Important note: Inter Partner Assistance S.A., which is part of the AXA Group, underwrite Home assistance for us, so this section may have a different structure and style to the rest of the policy wording.
